title: MCP: serve the agent skills as MCP prompts
body:
crates/mcp/src/server.rs answers prompts/list with an empty list. Serve skills/fieldcraft-meshing/SKILL.md (and the modelling skill) as MCP prompts (include_str!, prompts/get), so MCP clients get the same content as installed skills.

Part of #235.

comments.author: bomtobe-hgkim
comments.body: One useful parity check would be: each bundled skill appears in prompts/list under a stable name, and prompts/get returns the same Markdown as the skill source shipped with the app. That catches cases where a client can discover a prompt but gets missing or stale content. I work on Orke at BOMTOBE; I haven’t used Fieldcraft, so this is a test suggestion based on the issue, not a report of behavior.

comments.author: jyviko
comments.body: Thank you @bomtobe-hgkim, that's a good test to have: every bundled skill listed under a stable name in `prompts/list`, and `prompts/get` returning exactly the shipped skill source. It catches the discoverable-but-stale case nicely. We'll include it when this one is picked up.

comments.author: jyviko
comments.body: @bomtobe-hgkim and to say it plainly: FieldCraft is a young project and we welcome suggestions and contributions of any size. If anything here interests you, issues labelled `help wanted` or `good first issue` are a good place to start, and CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to claim one. Thanks again for stopping by!
